description: Look up a specific record — search by state name, chemical, certificate number, product name or any keyword. Searches one dataset's records (case-insensitive substring match across all fields). Returns up to 20 matching records, each with its url, source and verbatim source_quote so the answer can be checked.

query.description: Substring to match, case-insensitive, e.g. a state code, chemical name or standard number.

name: search_records
title: Search records in a dataset
